Adjustable Round Glasses
By Cobold The Fox!
Thanks for supporting me!


To Adjust The Glasses Parameters, change the Parameter values, then right click the Hotkey Node and select "Send Signal".

Parameters:
	GlassesLensSize 
		0 to 1
		Affects the size of the Lens.

	GlassesArmLength
		0 to 1
		Affects the length of the arms.
	
	GlassesArmRotation
		-1 to 1
		Affects the arms position, can be shut or open wider.
	
	GlassesWidth
		0 to 1
		Affects the spacing between the lenses.

Setup:------------
-	Configure the props you'd like to 		use with the right handed setup 		using the green nodes

-	Configure the props you'd like to 		use with the left handed setup			using the yellow nodes

-	Set the resolution of the monitor 		you are tracking movement on 			using the green parameter 			operation nodes beside this 			message. Specify a websocket/hotkey command in the cyan nodes above and below to trigger the graph and start drawing! You could also set up a hotkey using the same connections if preferred.
